name: on-this-day-spicetify
description: On This Day — albums released on this day in music history, as a Spicetify custom app.

scripts.catalog:generate: node .github/catalog/build-musicbrainz-catalog.mjs data/release-group.tar.xz data/catalog.json && node .github/catalog/split-musicbrainz-catalog.mjs data/catalog.json data/site/catalog
scripts.catalog:refresh: npm run catalog:download && npm run catalog:generate
